description: Fetch a web page and get back the words: headings, paragraphs and links, without the navigation, scripts or cookie banners. Set render:true for pages that are blank until JavaScript runs — same price. $0.005 per page, paid in USDC from your own wallet. No account and no API key, which is the point: an agent cannot sign up for one.

render.description: Run a real browser first, for pages that need JavaScript. Same price.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to read.

name: fetch_page
title: Read a web page as clean markdown
